verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce platform, but the evidence shows only Shopify-operated hosted endpoints, such as catalog.shopify.com and each merchant's /api/ucp/mcp. Webhook subscriptions are even registered server-side by Shopify. The open UCP spec and its reference implementations cover the protocol, not a self-hostable Shopify catalog, cart or checkout, so there is no evidence the core product can be self-hosted.
